name: zeffect_handle_emitter_loop_event
description: zEffect::HandleEmitterLoopEvent advances loop counters, handles count/time stop modes, clamps trigger time, and resets the emitter runtime when continuing.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session; coverage is functional through native emitter-loop event tests.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja decompilation for 0x45c310 validates loopIterationCount increment, loopElapsedSec accumulation, count stop mode, elapsed stop mode with non-negative threshold, triggerCurrentValue clamp to 86400, HandleEmitterResetEvent call when continuing, and return 0 or 2.
The native emitter-loop smoke verifies loop-count stop, elapsed stop, continuing reset behavior, loop counters, elapsed accumulation, and trigger clamp.
